Confederation plays the original DOS *Wing Commander* games, as they were. *Wing Commander* with *The Secret Missions* 1 and 2, and *Wing Commander II: Vengeance of the Kilrathi* with *Special Operations* 1 and 2, are included, by permission of Electronic Arts. *Wing Commander III: Heart of the Tiger* plays from a copy you have.

## Playing

Download the file for your computer, unpack it, and run `confederation` in the folder (`confederation.exe` on Windows). With no game named, a menu lists the games: pick one with the arrow keys and Enter, or the mouse. From a terminal, a game's short name starts it at once: `wc1`, `sm1`, `sm2`, `wc2`, `so1`, `so2`, and `wc3` once it has been given *Wing Commander III*'s folder. `confederation --help` lists the rest.

| Download | For |
|---|---|
| `win-x64` (zip) | Windows, 64-bit |
| `linux-x64` (tar.gz) | Linux, 64-bit |
| `osx-arm64` (tar.gz) | macOS on Apple silicon |
| `osx-x64` (tar.gz) | macOS on Intel |

The programs aren't signed. Windows may ask before running one from the internet (More info, then Run anyway). macOS keeps it from opening until it's allowed: in the unpacked folder, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine .` in a terminal, or allow it in System Settings, Privacy & Security.

Saves and settings go in a `Confederation` folder in your user's application data; the games' own files are never changed.
